rootCause: The original region pre-step gate persisted a complete refusal step and returned enter with empty messages, leaving the driver counter unchanged. A later admitted step could reuse the same turn/step coordinates.
fix: A detected denial returns reject even if its local reply cannot be written. The driver closes that turn before admitting more input.
candidateCorrection: The first candidate passed logical validation but failed native storage framing. It was rolled back. The installed candidate stores the header in an independent Zstandard frame and passed native reads.
githubActions: Account billing lock prevented the preceding cloud workflow from starting. Local full checks were run for this fix.
